messages:
Alex K: Quick heads up — opened a docs hotfix PR to add the status page link + a short known-issues/workaround section for the 13:42 outage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2434. Need 1 reviewer + docs approval. Preview: https://deploy-preview-2434--redwood-docs.netlify.app/status#incidents
Morgan L: Thanks — can you also add the auth token workaround that Ops asked for? Short curl snippet should be fine.
Alex K: Added a tiny "workaround" paragraph under the incident entry and included this snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokens/refresh` — keeps it minimal.
Jess P: Quick FYI: the docs link-checker CI is failing on the fragment anchor. Netlify preview shows the anchor works, but our link validator flags it.
Alex K: Ah — good catch. I changed the link to the explicit anchor path `/status#service-outage-2026-03-21` and re-ran link-checker locally.
Docs Bot: deploy-preview 2434 created — https://deploy-preview-2434--redwood-docs.netlify.app/status — preview build passed basic checks.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-462 assigned to @Morgan L. Please update status page before marking resolved.
Morgan L: I can update the status page once the postmortem draft is ready. Question: can we merge the docs PR before the status page has the specific anchor?
Jess P: Prefer not to merge a link that points to a missing anchor. Users get 404/fragments that don't scroll.
Alex K: Proposal: point to the stable `/status#recent-incidents` anchor which exists now, and Ops will add the specific incident + anchor within ~15min. That keeps the link valid. Need reviewers: @Jess P and @Morgan L. @Jess can you approve the CI fix?
Jess P: Approved pending the link pointing to an actual anchor. If Ops confirms they'll add the specific anchor within 15m, I can give final.
Morgan L: I'll add the incident entry and the anchor ASAP. If anything blocks, ping me for an emergency merge.
Alex K: Pushed a commit updating the PR to use `/status#recent-incidents` and added a short note that the incident entry will be added by Ops. Re-ran CI — link-checker now passes.
Jess P: LGTM. Merging now. :shipit:
Alex K: Thanks! Merged and tagged `docs-hotfix`. I'll add a brief change note to release notes and crosslink in the incident channel so customers see the workaround and status link.
Morgan L: I'll follow up in the incident thread once the status page entry + specific anchor is live.
Jess P: Thanks for the quick turnaround — nice work keeping the UX tidy. :thumbsup:
Alex K: Appreciate the reviews.
